item.title: GivingTuesday: Friends Fundraiser — Tue Dec 1 — Nutley Free Public Library
item.description:
December 1, 2026
Friends of the Nutley Public Library invite you to participate in GivingTuesday, which kicks off the generosity season and inspires us to give back to our community.
Please consider donating on December 1, 2026, and throughout the year by clicking here: DONATE.
GivingTuesday was launched in 2012 as a simple idea: to create a day that encourages people to do good. GivingTuesday has funded countless causes around the world and encourages residents to get involved in their communities.
Our cause is supporting the Nutley Public Library by funding Summer Reading Programs for kids, museum and art passes, musical performances, author meet-and-greets, learning new crafts and skills, just to name a few. Please visit friendsofnutleypl.membershiptoolkit.com to learn more about the Friends and becoming a member. You can also stop by and visit the Nutley Public Library at 93 Booth Drive, Nutley, NJ.
Thank you!
As President of the Friends of the Nutley Public Library, I

item.title: 2026 Class Gift Tabling - Day of Giving Information and Philanthropy Cord Pick-Up — Tue Dec 1, 12:00 PM — Student Center 2C02 - 2nd Floor Lobby
item.description:
Each year, our graduating class participates in a proud Class Gift tradition where members of the class invest in the University by supporting areas of Montclair State University that are most important to them. We invite the Class of 2026 to come together to show your support! All gifts to Montclair count! Make your gift to any area of campus you feel most passionate about – such as the Emergency Book Fund, The Red Hawk Pantry, your school or college, The Fund for Montclair State or athletic program. Your gift will pay it forward for future Red Hawks and kick-start your philanthropic connection to Montclair.
Commemorate your class year! Make a gift of at least $20.26 and you’ll receive your customized philanthropy cord to wear over your commencement robe. For a gift of $40, celebrate this milestone with your family, friends and colleagues by having your message displayed on the screen at the Commencement you will be participating in, and receive a customized philanthropy cords.

item.title: Weekly Food Recovery Initiative — Tue Dec 1, 2:00 PM — Blanton Hall Resident Kitchenette
item.description:
Join our weekly Food Recovery events, where dedicated volunteers and members gather to make a difference in our community. Each week, participants help collect perfectly good leftover food from Gourmet Dining and transport it to Blanton. There, the food is repackaged into individual microwavable containers and stocked in the food pantry, providing meals for those in need throughout the week. To Participate: RSVP to attend the event each week. Meet in Blanton Hall Residence Hall Kitchenette in the Communal Area (Tell them you are working with Food Recovery), Sign in via Event Pass and your set! Requirements:
Volunteers must be Food Safe Certified to participate. Complete the certification by following the step-by-step instructions provided in this link. Once certified, email your certification to foodrecoverynetwork@sgamsu.org to confirm your eligibility to participate.

item.title: Fasting and Prayer Group for Christians Online — Thu Dec 3, 7:37 PM
item.description:
North Jersey Bowling, Volleyball, Tennis & More Let’s join together in the meetup group chat to plan and discuss a 3 day water fast. We can decide if we want to fast for a common cause. There is power in prayer and fasting for Christians and even more so when we come together to do it. Just like in the Book of Esther; while her people were being persecuted, they came together to do a 3 day fast and call out to the Lord. God heard their cries and flipped the situation so they ended up benefiting from an event meant to wipe them out. \* This is not a weight loss program. \* I’m not a medical professional and can’t tell you if you are able to only drink water for 3 days. You should consult with your doctor. \*We can join the meetup’s event chat every Thursday to talk and plan. \*I’m open to ideas and suggestions, just message me and let me know, or leave a comment. \*Let me know if you have any questions.
Source: Meetup: NJ Bowling, Volleyball, Tennis & More

item.title: Inner Body Meditation (20 Minutes) — Sat Dec 5, 9:45 AM
item.description:
The Mindful Stream "Awareness of the inner body takes you beyond the mind." - Eckhart Tolle
In this mediation session we will bring our attention here: to the inner body. Sessions are suitable for newcomers, those experienced in Tolle's teachings and anyone wishing to remain completely anonymous. They will last around 20 minutes and cameras and microphones will be disabled.
(Depending on the situation, a free discussion may be held at the end with mics and cameras allowed.)
See you there!
Please be aware that sessions will close if no members have joined after 10 minutes.
Emrys also organises a free Work of Byron Katie online mediation group. Visit [this Meetup Group link](https://www.meetup.com/thework-runsfree/) for more information.

item.description:

Each week, participants help collect perfectly good leftover food from Gourmet Dining and transport it to Blanton. There, the food is repackaged into individual microwavable containers and stocked in the food pantry, providing meals for those in need throughout the week. To Participate: RSVP to attend the event each week. Meet in Blanton Hall Residence Hall Kitchenette in the Communal Area (Tell them you are working with Food Recovery), Sign in via Event Pass and your set! Requirements:
Volunteers must be Food Safe Certified to participate. Complete the certification by following the step-by-step instructions provided in this link. Once certified, email your certification to foodrecoverynetwork@sgamsu.org to confirm your eligibility to participate.
